caseName: National Endowment for the Arts v. Finley
caseNameFull: National Endowment for the Arts v. Finley

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of the Solicitor General is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, January 9, 1998. Brief of respondents is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, February 6, 1998. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, March 6,1998. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
